key.format: Use lowercase words joined by hyphens and colons, like save:fortitude or skill-check.

rollOption.format: Use a namespace and a name joined by colons, like self:condition:frightened.
rollOption.namespaceConflict: The pack {pack} already makes {namespace} {kind, select, known {known: a missing option is false} other {situational: a missing option is unknown}}. Give it the same kind, or use another namespace.

predicate.tooDeep: Predicates can nest at most {maximum} levels deep.

source.aonUrl: Link to one entry on 2e.aonprd.com, like https://2e.aonprd.com/Feats.aspx?ID=1.
source.unknownBook: {entry} cites {book} in sources[{index}], but {book} is not in the book registry. Cite a registered book, or add {book} to the registry.
source.homebrewPack: {entry} is in pack {pack}, but sources[{index}] is homebrew from pack {sourcePack}. A homebrew source names the entry’s own pack.

book.untitled: {book} has no title. Add its title key to BOOK_TITLES.
book.aonSourceUrl: Link to the book’s page under Sources on 2e.aonprd.com, like https://2e.aonprd.com/Sources.aspx?ID=216.

element.unknown: “{key}” is not a rule element Pioneer knows yet.
element.suboptionsNeedToggle: Only a toggle (toggleable: true) can offer suboptions.
element.adjustModeOrSuppress: Give a mode and a value, or suppress: true, but not both.
element.spellcastingSlugLength: A spellcasting entry’s slug may be at most {maximum} characters.
element.languageGrantOrSlots: Grant at least one language, or give slots to pick them in, or both.
element.actorTraitsAddOrRemove: Add at least one trait, or remove one, or both.
element.strikeShape: A Strike is either a fist, or an attack of its own with a slug, category and damage.

formula.unknownReference: “{found}” at position {position} is not a reference Pioneer knows. References look like @level, @attr.str or @prof.skill.athletics.
formula.foundryReference: “{found}” at position {position} is Foundry’s spelling. Write {suggestion} instead.
formula.referenceOutOfScope: “{found}” at position {position} reads an item’s value, which this formula has no item for.
formula.referenceNeedsWeapon: “{found}” at position {position} reads a weapon’s value. Only a statistic derived per weapon has one.
formula.referenceNeedsSpellcasting: “{found}” at position {position} reads a spellcasting entry’s value. Only a statistic derived per spellcasting entry has one.

statistic.duplicateSelector: Another statistic in this pack already uses the selector {selector}.
statistic.perKeyAttribute: A statistic derived per weapon or spellcasting entry takes its key attribute from each one, so it names none.
statistic.perSelectorLength: A statistic derived per weapon or spellcasting entry may have a selector of at most {maximum} characters, leaving room for each one’s slug.

proficiencyBonus.reference: “{found}” at position {position} is not @level. A proficiency bonus formula reads only @level.

entry.unknownKind: “{kind}” is not a content kind Pioneer has a schema for yet.
entry.idMismatch: The id must be the one derived from {key}: {expected}.
entry.slugKindMismatch: The slug must name the entry's kind first, as in {expected}.
entry.duplicateTrait: The trait {trait} is listed more than once.

richText.tooDeep: Rich text can nest at most {maximum} levels deep.
richText.tooLarge: Rich text can hold at most {maximum} JSON arrays and objects in all; each paragraph, list item and table row takes at least one.
richText.basicSave: Only saving throws (statistics starting save:) can be basic.
richText.widthOnLine: Only a line has a width; other areas have just a size.
richText.check: {hasDc, select, yes {DC {dc} } other {}}{basic, select, yes {basic } other {}}{statistic}{save, select, yes { save} other {}}{against, select, yes { against {againstName}} other {}}
richText.damage: {formula}{hasCategory, select, yes { {category}} other {}}{hasType, select, yes { {damageType}} other {}}

reference.attributeModifier: The character’s modifier for that attribute.
reference.cappedDexterity: The character’s Dexterity modifier, limited by the Dexterity cap of their armor.
reference.keyAttributeModifier: The character’s modifier for their class’s key attribute.
reference.ancestryHitPoints: The Hit Points the character’s ancestry gives.
reference.ancestrySpeed: The land Speed the character’s ancestry gives.
reference.classHitPoints: The Hit Points the character’s class gives each level, before Constitution.
reference.proficiencyBonus: The proficiency bonus for that statistic: the rank bonus plus level, or 0 when untrained.
reference.proficiencyRank: The proficiency rank for that statistic, from 0 (untrained) to 4 (legendary).
reference.statistic: The base of that statistic, before its modifiers, such as the spell attack modifier in a spell DC.
reference.itemLevel: The level of the item the rule element is on.
reference.itemValue: The value of the condition the rule element is on: 2 on Frightened 2.
reference.weaponAttributeModifier: The modifier the weapon attacks with: Strength, Dexterity for a ranged weapon, or the higher of the two for a finesse weapon.
reference.weaponDamageModifier: The modifier a Strike adds to damage: Strength for a melee or thrown weapon, half of a positive Strength (all of a negative one) for a propulsive one, none for any other ranged weapon.
reference.weaponProficiencyBonus: The proficiency bonus for the weapon’s category: simple, martial, advanced or unarmed.
reference.spellcastingAttributeModifier: The modifier for the spellcasting entry’s attribute.
reference.spellcastingProficiencyBonus: The proficiency bonus for the spellcasting entry’s tradition.

action.upTo: A variable cost starts at one, two or three actions and runs to more, at most six.

condition.impliesWithoutGrant: Grant this condition with a GrantItem rule too; listing it in implies does not apply it.

trait.duplicateKind: The kind {kind} is listed more than once.

deity.spellRank: A deity grants one spell per rank, and rank {rank} already has one.
deity.philosophy: A philosophy grants no divine font, domains or spells; leave this empty.

feat.onlyLevel1: A feat taken only at 1st level must be a 1st-level feat.

selector.skill: Use a skill’s selector, like skill:medicine.
selector.save: Use a saving throw’s selector, like save:reflex.

ritual.ranked: A rank for each skill replaces the one proficiency: name every skill of the check once, and leave proficiency out.

spell.castUpTo: A range of actions runs from fewer to more, like one to three; a reaction or free action has none.
spell.defenseEmpty: Give a save, the statistic the spell is against, or both; leave defense out when the spell has none.
spell.damageKey: The spell has no damage part {key} to heighten.
spell.heightenAbove: A heightened entry is for a rank above the spell’s own, {rank}.
spell.heightenEmpty: A heightened entry changes at least one of damage, range, area, targets, duration, casting time or traits; describe other changes in the text.
spell.variantEmpty: A spell variant changes at least one of casting time, range, area, targets, duration, defense, damage or heightening.
spell.against: A spell is against AC or a save’s DC, like ac or save:will.
spell.durationOwner: Only a turn has an owner; daily preparations are the caster’s.
spell.durationUpTo: A sustained duration already lasts up to its time; leave upTo out.
spell.targetUpTo: Only a number of targets can be “up to”; leave upTo out for any or all.
spell.targetWithin: Say where the targets are with all, and only with all: in the area or within range.

effect.badgeRange: The counter starts between its minimum and maximum.

trigger.autoApplyWithoutEvent: Give a trigger event too, or leave autoApply out: only an ability that fires on an event is applied automatically.

item.priceEmpty: Give at least one coin, or leave the price out when the item has none.

rune.etchedOnto: A {rune} rune isn’t etched onto {item, select, weapon {a weapon} armor {armor} shield {a shield} other {{item}}}.
rune.grade: A {rune} rune goes up to grade {max}; only reinforcing runes go higher.

consumable.ammunition: Only ammunition is fired as a kind of ammunition; use the ammunition category.

defences.weakness: Weakness{hasValue, select, yes { {value}} other {}} {target}{hasExceptions, select, yes {, except {exceptions}} other {}}
defences.resistance: Resistance{hasValue, select, yes { {value}} other {}} {target}{hasExceptions, select, yes {, except {exceptions}} other {}}
defences.failedConditional: {error} It applies only in some situations.

breakdown.conditionalBeatenBy: {hasSummary, select, yes {Applies when {summary}, but {name} already counts for as much.} other {{name} already counts for as much.}}
breakdown.inactive: Does not apply: its condition does not hold.
breakdown.overrideEffect: {mode, select, add {add} multiply {multiply} upgrade {upgrade} downgrade {downgrade} other {override}} {replaced} → {result}

statistics.noStrikes: No Strikes listed yet. Hold a weapon to add its Strike.

languages.none: No languages yet. Pick an ancestry first.
languages.open: {count, plural, one {# language left to add} other {# languages left to add}}

state.invalidAt: Needs a new choice at level {level}

slot.unknown: A choice the character no longer has
slot.rankSpell: {rank, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} rank spell
slot.rankSignatureSpell: {rank, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} rank signature spell

invalid.notOffered: This choice no longer offers that option, so it counts for nothing. Choose another.
invalid.contentNotLoaded: The content picked here is not loaded, so it counts for nothing.
invalid.boostTaken: A boost given with this one already raises that attribute, so it counts for nothing. Choose another.
invalid.flawTaken: Another voluntary flaw already lowers that attribute, so this one counts for nothing. Choose another.
invalid.skillTrained: The character is already trained in that skill, so this counts for nothing. Choose another.
invalid.skillRankCapped: This increase would raise that skill past the rank its level allows, so it counts for nothing. Choose another.
invalid.languageKnown: The character already knows that language, so this counts for nothing. Choose another.
invalid.spellNoAccess: This spell is uncommon or rare, and the character no longer has access to it, so it counts for nothing. Add it back or choose another.
invalid.spellUnfit: This slot no longer takes that spell (another tradition, or too high a rank), so it counts for nothing. Choose another.
invalid.spellNotInPool: This slot takes only certain spells (a divine font's, a school's curriculum) and no longer takes that one, so it counts for nothing. Choose another.
invalid.spellNotInRepertoire: A signature spell must be in the repertoire at its rank, and that one no longer is, so it counts for nothing. Choose another.
invalid.prerequisitesNotMet: The character doesn't meet this feat's prerequisites at its level. Choose another, or meet them first.
invalid.dedicationLocked: This dedication comes too soon after an earlier one, so it counts for nothing. Take more feats from that archetype first, or choose another.

empty.keyAttribute: Pick a class and its key attribute
empty.size: Pick an ancestry for its size
empty.traits: Pick an ancestry for its traits

inventory.unknownItem: An item no loaded content has

runes.reinforcing: {grade, plural, =1 {Minor Reinforcing} =2 {Lesser Reinforcing} =3 {Moderate Reinforcing} =4 {Greater Reinforcing} =5 {Major Reinforcing} other {Supreme Reinforcing}}

investments.off: Not worn or held, so it does nothing.
investments.nothingShown: Nothing it turns on shows on the sheet yet.

bulk.carried: {light, plural, =0 {Carrying {whole} Bulk} one {Carrying {whole} Bulk and # light item} other {Carrying {whole} Bulk and # light items}}
bulk.limits: Encumbered over {encumberedAfter} Bulk; can carry no more than {maximum} Bulk.

spellcasting.rank: {rank, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} rank

shop.more: Showing {shown} of {total}. Narrow the filters to see the rest.
shop.noneDescription: Change the filters or the search, or show everything.
shop.cannotAfford: Your coins don't cover the cost. Buy fewer, or add it without paying.
shop.cannotAffordKit: Your coins don't cover the kit's price. Add it without paying instead.

spellAccess.none: No access to uncommon, rare or unique spells yet.

focusSpells.heading: Focus spells
focusSpells.pool: Focus pool: {points, plural, one {# Focus Point} other {# Focus Points}}
focusSpells.castAt: Cast at {rank, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} rank, cantrips too
focusSpells.none: No focus spells yet. A choice that grants them may still be open.
